adv_none: needs readings over at least two weeks
adv_placeholder: estimated price: enter yours in Settings
findings_hint: Computed from the data, no AI
no_findings: Not enough data for findings yet.
commentary_hint: Gemma comments on the computed numbers only and gives recommendations.
cov_title: Electricity: measured by Shelly vs. unmetered rest
cov_hint: kWh per 24 h; bar height = main meter. Only days with every floor in Shelly.
dev_year_hint: From the Shelly daily totals; devices with at least 3 days of data
hourly_empty: No collector data yet – see the Collector tab.
hourly_shown: {shown} of {all} devices shown – click a name in the legend to show or hide it in both charts. Wh per hour; the dashed line is their total.
hourly_none: All devices hidden – click a name in the legend to show it.
daily_hint: kWh per day of the devices shown, stacked; the first and the last day are partial.
new_reading_hint: Take a photo of the meter: Gemma reads it and the checks test it. Or type the reading in.
photo_reading: Gemma is reading the photo… (a minute or two; longer when the model has to load first)
photo_review: ⚠ Read {reading}, but it failed a check; it waits on Review:
photo_failed: ✕ The photo could not be read:
photo_queued: The photo is saved. Gemma is not reachable now; read it later on the Import tab.
readings_hint: The whole number (bright) is the reading to report to the supplier; the decimals (grey) are only used in the calculations.
note_extra_digit_dropped: one digit too many left out
review_hint: Gemma's results that failed a check (or all of them while auto-accept is off). Correct the value and accept.
new_info: New meter photos: {photos} · new Shelly screenshots: {screenshots} · model: {model}
upload_hint: Saves the file to the photos or screenshots folder – then run the reading above.
tariffs_hint: Gross prices (incl. VAT) from the supplier's letter or bill. A price holds from its date until the next one of the same meter; an announced change can be entered ahead.
tariffs_none: No prices yet: the calculations use an estimate of {el} ct/kWh for electricity and {gas} ct/kWh for gas.
settings_hint: Copy the gas factors from the last gas bill. An empty field = the default.
s_decimals_electricity: Decimal digits on the electricity meter (red drums)
s_decimals_gas: Decimal digits on the gas meter (red drums)
s_auto_accept: Accept readings that pass every check automatically
s_sync_minutes: Sync with the collector every … minutes
err_ollama_missing: Ollama is not running – start it
err_bad_time: Enter the time as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM
is_no_reference: no other reading to compare with
is_counter_decreases: the register is lower than at the reading of {ref_ts} ({ref_value})
is_increase_too_large: increase {delta} in {days} d is above the limit {limit}/day (against {ref_ts})
in_coverage: The Shelly plugs see {pct} % of the house on average; ~{unmetered_kwh} kWh/day runs through unmetered circuits (stove, oven, lights, pumps, network…).
in_gas_trend: Gas: lately Ø {recent} m³/day against {start} m³/day at the start.
